description: Set the listing words of ONE product or ONE model for a channel — amazon (title up to 75 characters and up to 5 selling points) or ebay (title up to 80 characters, no points) — in the marketplace's language, which the CRM picks from the channel's marketplace (pass locale only when it says the channel sells in several languages). Which title a listing gets: the product's own words, else its model's title plus its colour or size («DEMI Borsa duffle 40 L, Blu»), else the product's name in that language. A model's title is also the title of Amazon's variation parent and of eBay's listing with variations — set it once per model instead of per colour. Write from the product's facts (get_product) and what the user said — never invent a claim. Saved in the CRM: new listings carry them; an existing Amazon offer gets them with update_amazon_listing_content parts ["texts"], an existing parent with update_amazon_variation_parent. title null and no points removes them. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

bulletPoints.description: Selling points in order; empty strings are dropped. Amazon shows up to 5 (500 characters each); eBay has none — send [] for eBay.

locale.description: The language the words are written in. Omit it: the CRM uses the channel's marketplace language (amazon.it → it). Needed only when the channel sells in several languages here (eBay on ebay.it and ebay.de).

modelId.description: A product model id (get_product shows the model). Words set on the model go to every article of it without words of its own — as «model title, colour» — and are the title of Amazon's variation parent and of eBay's listing with variations. Give exactly one of productId or modelId.

platform.description: The channel the words are for: amazon (title up to 75 characters and selling points) or ebay (title up to 80 characters, no points).

productId.description: A product id returned by search_products — this article's own words, which win over its model's. Give exactly one of productId or modelId.

title.description: The title in the marketplace's language, within the channel's limit; null to fall back (an article to its model's title plus its colour or size, then its name; a model to its name in that language). null with no points removes the words.

name: set_channel_texts
title: Set listing words for a channel
